us|573192227.title: Works Sometimes
us|573192227.text: Songs stops playing on Wi-Fi and is really bad on cell data.   Constantly have to restart app for it to work.

us|573192227.title: It had potential
us|573192227.text:
I’m very disappointed in this product and lack of customer support!

I email this company from within the software and got NO RESPONSE for a product I paid for. 

There is no option to sign up to the company and the software has issues such as many times it just stops and doesn’t play the next track!

us|573192227.title: fantastic music player
us|573192227.text: i wish i could figure out how to just edit my old review from when there was a major issue with the app, but i'll figure that out after this. this is an INCREDIBLE app, i love being able to store all of my music in one spot and the developers are very responsive when something starts acting up, every update has made the app more functional and efficient, ive been using it for years and i always recommend it to anyone who wants to keep their entire music library on their phone.
